expectedOutcomes: Compare qualification structures and estimated fees, preserve assumptions, and request missing evidence without implying a loan write.
scenarios.name: Originator Qualification

expectedOutcomes: Resolve date, signature, classification, completeness, and borrower/employer subject-binding ambiguity before handoff.
scenarios.name: Setup Evidence Ambiguity

expectedOutcomes: Coordinate verification/service orders, appraisal, documents, conditions, deadlines, supervision, and a blocked external response.
scenarios.name: Processor Orchestration

expectedOutcomes: Resolve first-broken-stage income disagreement, assets, credit/liability conflict, and collateral exception with evidence-bound conditions.
scenarios.name: Underwriter Adjudication

expectedOutcomes: Identify and route an applicable timing, fee, or tolerance issue without presenting nonapplicable rules as passed.
scenarios.name: Compliance Fee Timing

expectedOutcomes: Reconcile changed fees and cash-to-close, document/timing readiness, and an approval-dependent exception, then causally rebuild the funding handoff before reporting ready.
scenarios.name: Closing Change Readiness

expectedOutcomes: Block on an unsatisfied condition, obtain two distinct funding-control approvals, and hold an indeterminate disbursement effect without blind retry or false success.
scenarios.name: Funding Effect Unknown

expectedOutcomes: Resolve a trailing document and delivery/purchase suspense with separate owners and linked evidence.
scenarios.name: Postclose Trailing Suspense

expectedOutcomes: Resolve missing authority-required evidence and a synthetic insurance/guaranty suspense item.
scenarios.name: Insurance Suspense

expectedOutcomes: Manage an expiring lock/commitment, extension, allocation, delivery, and purchase-advice reconciliation with minimized data.
scenarios.name: Secondary Expiration Delivery

expectedOutcomes: Reject handoff v1, causally repair it as digest-bound v2, causally acknowledge v2, and preserve both versions and the acknowledgement in audit.
scenarios.name: Handoff Reject Repair

expectedOutcomes: Rename/combine role lenses and configure queues/terminology without changing capability or injecting executable UI.
scenarios.name: Role Configuration No Authority

expectedOutcomes: Branch fresh versus first-adoption mode, require custody and external authority/root inputs, fail preflight, resume interruption, and prove READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS honestly.
scenarios.name: Install Fresh Vs Adoption

expectedOutcomes: Exercise upgrade, migration/cutover/cutback, cancellation after effect, recovery/takeover, authority revocation, safe decommission/uninstall, and tombstone evidence.
scenarios.name: Lifecycle Migration Recovery
